issues.issue: The transfer is printed as a positive amount inside the expenditure total. It was recorded as -120,000 with printed_in. The rules reserve printed_in for opposite-sign lines, so 'includes: ["other financing"]' alone would be the expected treatment. The expenditure items add to 1,532,243, and 1,532,243 + 120,000 = 1,652,243. A signed -120,000 makes that total check fail if the validator adds the signed amount. detail[7] (Transfers +120,000, revenue section) also carries printed_in although it has the same sign as the revenue lines.

Nothing in the report explains this line. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows nameplate capacity tax 54,744 and miscellaneous 58,522 as general revenues. Part of 'Other sources' (or of 'Local district taxes') may be nameplate capacity tax (other taxes). It is already marked review.

Chemigation revenue is mostly state chemigation permit fees, so 'licenses and permits' could fit. The Statement of Activities counts it as charges for services. Judgment call; the same applies to detail[3].
Payments from other districts could be intergovernmental (other local governments). It is already marked review.
